name: Senma Rentarou no Jikenbo - Shisha o Yobu Honoo
original_name: 千間廉太郎の事件簿　死者を呼ぶ炎
source:
Main character leaves a company for freelancing. He is invited to his brother's Tokyo detective company. However, his brother is away for a week and leaves business to protagonist and the assistant. The two of them successfully solve several minor incidents and now are about to take up a serious case.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角辭去公司工作，開始自由接案。他受邀來到哥哥在東京經營的偵探事務所。然而哥哥離開一週，把業務交給主角和助手。兩人順利解決了幾起小案件，現在即將接手一宗重大案件。

［來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]］
